meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会扫描文字,找出像机器生成的套路(如堆砌套话、节奏死板),再按你选的方式处理:只标出问题、直接重写、或原地修改文件;重写时保留原作者语气,不新增内容。
howto.when: 当你要它去掉文章里的AI腔、清理AI写作痕迹,或审计README、更新日志、博客等文字时触发;说“检测”“只标记”等词会切到只检测模式。

say.text: 帮我检查这段文字,列出AI腔的地方,别改写。
say.note: 进入只检测模式,按严重程度分组列出问题。

say.text: 把这篇博客重写一遍,去掉机器味,保留我的语气。
say.note: 按默认重写模式处理,并说明改了什么。

say.text: 原地编辑这个文件,改掉AI痕迹,别动引用和代码块。
say.note: 进入原地编辑模式,只改动目标片段。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans your text for machine-like patterns (stock phrases, stiff rhythm), then acts per your choice: flag only, rewrite, or edit in place; rewrites keep the author's voice and add nothing new.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to remove AI-isms, clean up AI-sounding prose, or audit a README, changelog, blog post, etc.; saying "detect" or "flag only" switches to detect-only mode.

say_en.text: Check this text and list the AI tells, but don't rewrite.
say_en.note: Switches to detect mode, grouped by severity.

say_en.text: Rewrite this blog post to remove machine flavor, keep my voice.
say_en.note: Uses default rewrite mode and summarizes changes.

say_en.text: Edit this file in place to clean AI tells; leave quotes and code blocks untouched.
say_en.note: Enters edit mode, touching only flagged spans.
